correctness.rationale: The graph is defined by the exact 24 edges in artifacts/verify_masks.py and independently by an upper-triangular adjacency table in verify_signatures.py. All 276 edge pairs are separated by landmark bitmask OR iff the set resolves; exhaustive choose(12,0..5) tests give no bases below five and 192 five-landmark optima. Pairwise one-vertex exchanges across all 192 bases give 1152 jump and 428 original-graph-adjacent slide edges. Complete BFS from every basis certifies connectivity and eccentricity histograms 5:192 and 6:120,7:72, as well as the slide degree distribution 2:28,3:32,4:48,5:32,6:32,7:8,8:8,10:4. Both independent implementation source files were examined and an additional local reconstruction gave the same counts. Finite exhaustive proof is sufficient because the graph and all configurations are finite.
